scope: Bounded current public expectations and repricing review; no model/PDF edits or investment trade. Twelve source pages/lead records considered, with weaker aggregators explicitly excluded.
verdict: No supported early-convergence thesis identified in this pass. Current accessible professional views already recognize heavy investment, negative2027FCF and server supply limits. The new matched public forecast evidence weakens the claim that our spending/revenue assumptions identify an overlooked near-term disappointment. This does not prove all investors agree, or that later cash disappointment cannot occur.

decisive_new_observation.reasoning: No newly demonstrated revenue shortfall follows from comparing its69.20/80.73Bsales with our larger capital-denominator totals; the latter are not precisely matched GAAP forecasts. A substantial cash expectation gap needs evidence beyond these approximate comparisons.

cash_measure_bridge.issuer_adjusted_FCF: GAAP operating cash minus gross PPE plus capital government incentives plus net SCIP partner contributions minus finance-lease payments. This includes financing and accounting conventions absent from unlevered economic cash.
cash_measure_bridge.our_measure: EBIT after recurring economic SBC, unlevered taxes, D&A, physical capex, WC, leases and minority economic reserves plus finite capital-credit cash/basis effects. Capitalized interest and ordinary financing handled separately.
cash_measure_bridge.consequence: Do not subtract our-10.18B from an adjusted-FCF consensus and call the difference an earnings surprise; do not compare economic EBIT with EPS as though they share an accounting basis.
